# Maaef Group

> A Lucknow-based sovereign collective — an integrated business group offering creative, production, marketing, community, and government-procurement services under one umbrella across four distinct arms.

## Overview
Maaef Group is an integrated business collective headquartered in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Operating on four value currencies — Attention, Precision, Trust, and Time — Maaef provides end-to-end strategy, creative production, distribution, performance tracking, community networking, and government procurement in-house.

## Group Arms & Capabilities

### 1. Maaef Media House (Creative Growth & Performance Marketing)
- Performance marketing & paid social campaign management
- Organic social media strategy, content calendars, and execution
- Short-form video & content production (reels, carousels, brand storytelling)
- Cold email outreach systems & lead-generation infrastructure
- LLMO (Large Language Model Optimisation) — helping brands get surfaced accurately by AI search tools and assistants
- Vernacular content creation (Hindi-English) for regional and cultural storytelling

### 2. Maaef Studios (Premium Print & Visual Production)
- Print production & design (premium finish, high-quality output)
- Brand films & video production
- Lookbooks, catalogues, & brand documentation
- Product visualization tools — 3D/AR viewers for e-commerce and retail
- Pricing & market-positioning tools for print industry clients

### 3. Maaef Afterhours (Networking & Community)
- Curated in-person networking events for founders and professionals
- Community-building initiatives based in Lucknow with expansion in progress

### 4. Maaef Enterprises Pvt Ltd (Government Procurement)
- GeM (Government e-Marketplace) portal operations
- Focus categories: print materials and irrigation equipment/supplies
- Government bid management & client servicing

## Sectors Served
- Restaurant & Hospitality
- Real Estate
- Government & Public Sector
- Enterprise & High-Growth Founders
